title: Neon Skyport - Client & Creative Director Brainstorm
clientNotes: We want an iconic cover scene for our neo-noir graphic novel: a flying vehicle terminal suspended between kilometer-high skyscrapers in rainy Neo-Kyoto.

rawDialogue.text: Imagine standing at the edge of a suspended skyport on the 120th floor. It's pouring rain, and below us, neon holographic billboards in magenta and cobalt are cutting through the heavy mist.
I love that. Let's add a sleek vintage-futuristic hover-coupe parked at the landing pad with its gullwing doors open, glowing exhaust cooling down in the wet night air.
Yes! And a solitary courier in an illuminated high-collar trench coat looking out over the endless city canyons. The mood should feel melancholic yet strikingly epic and cinematic.

title: Astral Celestial Forge - 3-Person Worldbuilding Session
clientNotes: Developing the visual keyframe for the heart of the Star-Smith Guild: an ancient forge heated by a contained dying dwarf star.

rawDialogue.text: The entire chamber is made of dark star-metal obsidian. Floating in the center inside massive magnetic containment rings is a miniature white dwarf star roaring with solar flares.
A towering celestial blacksmith with crystalline skin is hammering a cosmic blade on an anvil made of comet stone. Every strike sends cascading embers shaped like miniature constellations.
We need extreme contrast: blinding solar white and gold in the center, transitioning to deep cosmic violet shadows and floating dust motes catching the stellar glow.

title: Solaris Biophilic Tower - Client Monologue & Vision
clientNotes: A next-generation solarpunk vertical forest tower designed for Mediterranean coastal climate.

rawDialogue.text: I want a towering spiral skyscraper woven with cascading vertical gardens, olive trees, and hanging jasmine. The architecture uses curved white limestone terraces and photovoltaic glass sails that catch the Mediterranean golden hour sun over crystal blue waters.
